entities.summary: John Wingate Weeks was an American banker and politician from Massachusetts. A Republican, he served as Mayor of Newton from 1902 to 1903, a United States representative from 1905 to 1913, United States senator from 1913 to 1919, and secretary of war from 1921 to 1925.
